checks.name: FRESH: one stage only, visible conditions and locked-card guidance
ROUTES: debug, fixture, direct, friend and daily links cannot jump locked stages
MIGRATION: exact old same-run evidence opens only its continuous prefix
MIGRATION: v1 totals, missing first stage, corrupt proofs and unsupported data never grant access
COMPLETION: exact boundary pass/fail, next stage, repeated result, reload and all clear
DEBUG: accelerated result never saves a clear or unlocks another stage
CHEEK SESSION: discoveries across separate visits do not clear the single-session task
PENDING FRIEND: a locked invitation keeps its course and opens after the preceding clear
LAYOUT: desktop, landscape and denied storage retain one initial game
ERRORS: no JavaScript, HTTP asset or console errors

method: Constructed historical-save fixtures and injected finished-engine results verify deterministic boundaries and UI/store wiring. Fresh game input and six cheek gestures use trusted Playwright pointer input and real elapsed time. These fixtures are not human playtest evidence.
limitations: 390px mobile, desktop and landscape viewports are emulated. Linux WebKit is not a physical iPhone. Difficulty calibration is in a separate playtest report.
